easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Haywire Mite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Haywire Mite by paying {1}.
Repeat.
